purpose: Shared component pins and truthful readiness status for public intake, isolated PusingCuk execution, and four-repository synchronization.

authority_model.Founder-OS: Durable decisions, constraints, recovery context, curated knowledge index.
authority_model.kawasan-masjid-core: Runtime truth, authorization, operational data, AI orchestration, and evidence.
authority_model.kawasan-masjid-public: Public-safe web experience; never a second backend or private knowledge store.
authority_model.pusingcuk: Canonical language, specification, interpreter/native runtime, registered .cuk rules, and conformance.

capabilities.native_rule: One deterministic registered .cuk rule; exact source commit and source hash are pinned.
capabilities.founder_knowledge: Bounded lexical ranking over a curated 20-document public-safe multi-repository index; validates immutable source URLs against repository, path and source commit; returns source authority/evidence/claim status and uses deterministic validated citation footers. This remains lexical retrieval, not vector search.
capabilities.local_llm: Ollama provider adapter source; default model qwen3:4b; no hosted LLM API key required for local inference.
capabilities.runner_boundary: Authenticated local HTTP gateway; fixed program allowlist with immutable source hashes, strict request/output limits, no requested capabilities, and mandatory digest-pinned Docker sandbox. The sandbox runs with network disabled, read-only root, no Linux capabilities, non-root UID, and memory/CPU/PID/time limits.
capabilities.model_training: Not implemented; PusingCuk is a language/runtime, not a trained LLM.
capabilities.production_runner: Docker sandbox image and runner code are CI-tested; no publicly reachable runner service is declared by this lock. CORE only records a successful result after the runner returns the expected program hash, source commit, and Docker image ID.
capabilities.repository_freeze: Not approved until migration parity, auth/data/audit preservation, backups, restore and rollback are verified.
capabilities.additional_pusingcuk_rule: budget.sufficiency.v1 is registered in the authenticated local HTTP runner and covered by a six-case fixture in the Docker sandbox CI. Production execution requires PUSINGCUK_RUNNER_URL and PUSINGCUK_RUNNER_TOKEN configured in the CORE Edge Function.
capabilities.cross_repository_sync: CORE CI fetches integration/system-lock.json from main in Founder-OS, CORE, PUBLIC and PusingCuk, then requires schema version, sync_id and parsed JSON content to match the checked-out CORE lock. This is an automated drift detector, not a claim that every repository commit SHA should be identical.
capabilities.public_intake: CORE public-intake Edge Function validates a strict public payload, rate limits by HMAC-hashed IP, stores the request and audit events in a private RLS-enabled schema, and returns a traceable intake ID. Requests remain rule_pending until a configured sandbox returns verified evidence.

PUBLIC form build/deployment passed. No configured runner URL/token or public end-to-end execution result has been verified; do not claim production rule execution or mark a request rule_succeeded until the sandbox callback is live.

PyInstaller packaging passed separately. The runner remains local-only unless deployed on a protected host.

knowledge_grounding_update.status: 20-curated-documents-preserved; intake contract remains outside index until a reviewed primary decision/masterplan source is selected
knowledge_grounding_update.status_note: The existing 20-document public-safe index and all grounding/provenance tests remain unchanged. No new Founder-OS decision/masterplan source was added because no new primary Founder decision or masterplan source was identified. Public intake code and Docker sandbox are committed and CI-tested, but production end-to-end rule execution remains unverified until a protected sandbox service and its Edge Function secrets are configured.

cross_repository_lock_validation.assertion: The checked-out CORE lock and all three remote main locks have the same schema_version, sync_id and parsed JSON content, checked via the GitHub Contents API.

freeze_gates: All required CORE operations are replaced and behavior/security parity tests pass.
Founder-OS decision history and recovery context are preserved with provenance.
All callers, Edge Functions, workflows, schedules and public contracts are inventoried.
Backup/restore, rollback and security review have been rehearsed and explicitly accepted by the Founder.
